output.summary: The admitted-patient ED length-of-stay rise is almost entirely boarding (about 3.0 of 3.2 h). A schedule-determined pilot on 4 West cut boarding from 4.6 h to 2.3 h without spillover to the other wards, which supports the discharge-timing link. The evening cleaning cut and the triage-provider cut are unresolved contributors. Extend the huddle. Do not approve the travel-nurse contract funded by deferring case managers.
